_comment: Trained in safe_rl (branch feat/pace-actuators), tasks Rl-Velocity-Go2 / Safe-Rl-Go2, on the identified PACE actuator model. 'normal' tracks the velocity command, 'safe' is the zero-command recovery policy resumed from it; both share this contract. Observation normalizer is inside the graph. imu_lin_acc is the accelerometer reading averaged over the policy step. See the README for the observation layout.
